title: La Golondrina - Galveston printed piano right hand
composer: Narciso Serradell Sevilla (standard attribution; Galveston print leaves composer and arranger unnamed)
edition: Thos. Goggan & Bro., Galveston, plate 29512. Copyright 1883 by L. W. Stevenson, Laredo. Cover dated March 1889.
scope: Complete harmonized treble staff on printed pp. 2–3, including the introduction, both pairs of repeat endings and the instrumental coda. A second strophe is a separate performance choice.
editorial: Preview tempo is an editorial quarter-note 84 BPM. Fermatas use nominal values and the upper-staff pitches retain the written key signature and local accidentals.

Beam grouping, parallel canto and the common-time measure lengths govern the unmarked triplet readings. The long introduction scale is read as four triplets. In the coda's first bar, the quarter-note pulse supports two triplet groups after the opening half-note chord.

The crossed grace chord in the verse second ending and refrain first ending takes two ticks from the following dotted eighth. The descending four sixteenths in the refrain second ending belong to the piano transition and do not enter the canto guide.

The introduction's 66-tick final bar and 30-tick vocal pickup share one nominal bar of time. The final coda measure keeps its printed 66 ticks. Its first upper notehead is faint. Read F6 from its position above the third ledger line and the preceding ascending octaves.
